0.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_GREETING_ADKIRAGH_000_000
0.description: Come, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, let us be about the business of bringing the Hard Place back from the financial brink.

1.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_GREETING_ADKIRAGH_000_001
1.description: Welcome, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, welcome! This hall has regained some of its former liveliness, and it is in no small part due to your efforts.

2.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_GREETING_ADKIRAGH_000_002
2.description: Well, well, if it isn't <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! For your contributions towards keeping the Hard Place in a good place, you have my heartfelt gratitude.

3.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_GREETING_ADKIRAGH_000_003
3.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, ever a sight for sore piggy eyes. Thanks to you, I scarcely have a moment's rest! Rest assured that's a good thing!

4.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_GREETING_ADKIRAGH_000_004
4.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, my most dependable partner. What brings you here today? Have you a delivery to make? Perhaps new garb for yours truly to try? Whichever it is, it does me well to see you.

44.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_TUTORIAL_000_000
44.description: Help Adkiragh achieve his goals by delivering collectables. For more information, speak with him and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Learn about custom deliveries<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

55.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_TUTORIAL_001_000
55.description: In making your first successful delivery, you have begun to earn Adkiragh's trust.

56.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_TUTORIAL_001_001
56.description: With each successful delivery, Adkiragh will grow more and more satisfied with your efforts. Fill the gauge completely and Adkiragh's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>satisfaction level<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will increase, giving you the opportunity to learn more about your business partner.

57.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_TUTORIAL_001_002
57.description: You can make up to six deliveries in a given week. Deliver the items Adkiragh needs, and deliver them often to win the trust and praise of your new business partner!

59.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_001_000
59.description: The Ishgardians may be prim and proper to a fault, but by the same token they boast rich traditions. These essentials embody that, and their exquisite ornamentation promises to enhance the enjoyment of our Ishgardian cuisine.

60.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_001_001
60.description: Hmmm, a marvelous fragrance. The produce of this land is ideal for brewing a fine spirit─one that shan't punish revelers the morrow after. Such a beverage is certain to win over our patrons.

61.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_001_002
61.description: Great buuz requires great ingredients. With what you have brought, I can make buuz the equal of any found in my homeland, the dough irresistibly fluffy and the filling tantalizingly succulent.

62.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_001_003
62.description: For a space to be conducive to relaxation, all of its furnishings must be in harmony, and you have clearly taken this tenet to heart. A furnishing such as this will help to ensure that the Hard Place is our patrons' home away from home.

63.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_001_004
63.description: Distilled from fermented mare's milk, arkhi is a popular─and potent─spirit in my homeland, and an essential part of any celebration. With this, we may look forward to much merrymaking here in Idyllshire!

64.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_002_000
64.description: In a frozen land such as Ishgard, 'tis hardly surprising that stews cooked over an open fire are popular fare. With this, we can kindle a cookfire of an intensity ideal for making such dishes.

65.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_002_001
65.description: Using a material with superior heat conducting properties such as this, we can expect wonderful flavors to develop during the aging process. I can scarcely wait to sample the results!

66.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_002_002
66.description: While the use of spices is limited in my native cuisine, a good businessman knows to adapt to his patrons. By offering buuz seasoned with this spice, we can speak to the palates of more of Idyllshire's diverse visitors.

67.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_002_003
67.description: Even in simple things such as materials for furnishings, you do not compromise. And indeed, we must not compromise where it concerns the satisfaction of our patrons.

68.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_002_004
68.description: A batch of arkhi is only as good as its vat, and with such fine materials, we can expect our brews to come out exactly as we intended. 'Tis well worth the additional effort!

69.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_003_000
69.description: Ah, a truly fine specimen of northern oyster, heavy with succulent flesh. We must see this to our diners while it is still fresh!

70.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_003_001
70.description: Well now, if this isn't used to make seaweed tonic. Such a beverage may prove too exotic for most, but 'tis undoubtedly in the character of the Hard Place to offer such unusual items.

71.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_003_002
71.description: Look at these bright eyes and shiny scales! With some preparation to remove the muddy flavor, this chakrafish will cook up to be a most delectable morsel. A fine substitute for dzo, the meat of choice back home.

72.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_003_003
72.description: Well, well, if this isn't a wicked wartfish I see! You've done well to reel in such a rare─and usable─fish. Not only is its flesh good for eating; being relatively odorless, its oil is also ideal for use as fuel.

73.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_KNOWLEDGE_ADKIRAGH_003_004
73.description: Oho, this salmon is far from home indeed, a kindred spirit to yours truly! Whether sliced up and served raw or rubbed in salt and grilled over charcoal, it makes a most toothsome accompaniment to spirits.

74.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_JUDGEMENT_ADKIRAGH_000_000
74.description: Now then, let me examine it by the light... Yes, the quality is more than adequate. Our patrons will have no cause for complaint.

75.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_JUDGEMENT_ADKIRAGH_000_001
75.description: Now then, let me examine it by the light... Hmmm, yes, there is no faulting the quality. You never cease to impress me with your work, my friend.

76.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_JUDGEMENT_ADKIRAGH_000_002
76.description: Now then, let me examine it by the light... By Azim, the quality is transcendent! The manifestation of an ideal I did not think existed! You, my friend, are a miracle worker!

77.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_JUDGEMENT_ADKIRAGH_000_003
77.description: Now then, let me examine it by the light... Yes, the quality is above reproach, befitting the opulence that the Hard Place endeavors to deliver. Very well done!

78.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_JUDGEMENT_ADKIRAGH_000_004
78.description: Now then, let me examine it by the light... Oho! In a word, the quality is superb! I'm thoroughly impressed, and I've no doubt that our patrons will be too!

79.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_FULLBAG_000_000
79.description: Unable to obtain your reward. Your inventory is full.

80.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_FULLBAG_000_001
80.description: To collect your reward, make room in your inventory and speak with Adkiragh once more.

81.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_BEFRANKUP_ADKIRAGH_000_000
81.description: Thanks to you, we have everything we require. The time is come to put our new menu to the proof. Azim as my witness, we will restore the Hard Place to its former glory!

82.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_BEFRANKUP_ADKIRAGH_001_000
82.description: Thanks to you, our very own house spirit is now ready to be served. I must confess to feeling somewhat nervous, as if I were sending my child into his first battle. Not that I have any children, of course!

83.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_BEFRANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_000
83.description: Thanks to you, we're now ready to offer our special buuz. Our patrons are bound to love this variation on the traditional recipe. I must hand it to the Mol─it never would have occurred to me to use catfish in the filling.

84.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_BEFRANKUP_ADKIRAGH_003_000
84.description: Thanks to you, we've amassed a fine selection of furnishings. By ensuring that the Hard Place is well appointed, we can keep our patrons comfortable. And a comfortable patron is a happy patron!

85.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_001_000
85.description: You'll be pleased to hear that our Ishgardian dishes have proven tremendously popular with our regular patrons. They're so impressed, in fact, they all go off promising to spread the word. Little by little, we're regaining the custom we once enjoyed.

86.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_MELODIE_001_001
86.description: Thank you for your patronage! We look forward to your next visit!

87.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_MAPOPO_001_002
87.description: You really are a natural at this. But...er, don't you think it's about time you shed with that outfit?

88.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_MELODIE_001_003
88.description: Well, there's no guarantee that my pursuers won't return. Besides, I quite enjoy dressing like Master Adkiragh!

90.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_MELODIE_001_005
90.description: Mistress Mapopo, I have been meaning to ask─how long have you been working at the Hard Place?

91.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_MAPOPO_001_006
91.description: How long? Why, only as long as it's existed!

92.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_MAPOPO_001_007
92.description: I used to be a treasure hunter, you see. But one day, I ran afoul of a terrible fiend. It would've made a meal of me had the chief not chanced to be nearby. Ahhh, I'll never forget the sight of him standing over the creature's bloody corpse... So majestic, so dreamy...

93.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_MAPOPO_001_008
93.description: A-Anyway! The chief saved my life that day. And I've been at his side ever since.

94.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_MELODIE_001_009
94.description: Oh, my! To think that Master Adkiragh is a skilled warrior as well! Is there nothing he cannot do?

95.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_001_010
95.description: Well, 'twas not for naught that I was favored to become khan of the largest tribe on the Steppe. Next to my brilliance, that self-proclaimed Sun would appear as a pallid candle! Hah hah hah...hah?

96.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_MELODIE_001_011
96.description: Khan? Largest tribe on the Steppe?

97.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_001_012
97.description: Uwaaah! P-Pay me no mind! 'Twas but idle musing, nothing more!

98.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_MAPOPO_001_013
98.description: <sigh> You always do that, chief. If you don't want to talk about something, you shouldn't bring up the subject.

99.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_001_014
99.description: E-Enough talk! Everyone, return to your duties!

100.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_000
100.description: Glad tidings, my friend─our house spirit is enjoying unprecedented popularity! Mapopo is beside herself with joy!

101.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ALGHU_002_001
101.description: (-Bewildered Au Ra-)At long last, we made it... Gods, please let him be here...

102.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_TELEBOGE_002_002
102.description: (-Travelworn Au Ra-)He will be! He <hex:021A020203>must<hex:021A020103>, after all that we've been through...

103.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_003
103.description: Alghu? Teleboge? What are you two doing here!?

104.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ALGHU_002_004
104.description: That voice! It could only be...

105.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_TELEBOGE_002_005
105.description: Chief! It's you! It's really you!

106.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_006
106.description: Hmmm... <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I believe you can be trusted with my secret.

107.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ALGHU_002_007
107.description: Be not astonished, but the chief was once poised to become khan. Not just any khan, mind you, but that of the largest tribe on all the Steppe─the Adarkim.

108.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_TELEBOGE_002_008
108.description: But with great standing comes great risk, and after eight assassination attempts and four sham marriages, he abruptly disappeared with nary a word.

109.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ALGHU_002_009
109.description: We two are sworn to serve the chief till death. Thus did we set out in search of him. First we scoured the length and breadth of the Steppe, but when we failed to find him there, we decided to venture farther afield. And after a grueling journey during which we were runaways, stowaways, and castaways in turn, we finally arrived here.

110.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_010
110.description: H-How can this be? How can you learn the truth of my illustrious identity and not be surprised? <hex:021A020203>Impressed<hex:021A020103>?

112.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_A1_002_001
112.description: I met your brother on the Steppe.

113.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_A1_002_002
113.description: I don't pry into people's past.

114.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_011
114.description: You met my brother? And he's searching for me, you say? That is...not wholly unexpected.

115.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_012
115.description: Hm-hmmm. As a roaming soul yourself, you understand─as do the people of Idyllshire. Here, what matters is not your past, but what you do for the settlement's future.

116.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_013
116.description: Now, you two─how did you know to find me here?

117.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ALGHU_002_014
117.description: Well, chief, many adventurers come through Reunion these days. Through them, we heard tell of a tavern far to the west. Imagine our surprise when we learned that the proprietor was a man named Adkiragh!

118.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_015
118.description: Ugh, that my whereabouts should be exposed in such a manner... Well, 'tis unlikely that any would-be assassins would follow me all this way.

119.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_TELEBOGE_002_016
119.description: We did have one doubt, however. If you'd go so far as to conceal your face, why in the world would you go by your true name?

120.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_TELEBOGE_002_017
120.description: But lo and behold, it really was you. We're quite baffled, to be honest.

121.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_018
121.description: A-Ahem! Such trifling details aside, you must not tell the others of this. It would not do to cause unnecessary concern.

122.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_003_000
122.description: People are coming from near and far for our special buuz. This would not have been possible without you to supply the ingredients─and my illustrious self to make the mouthwatering stuff, of course!

123.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_003_001
123.description: But to another matter. There is something with which I require your...discreet assistance. Recently, Melodie claims to have seen a Xaela man here in Idyllshire. By her judgment, he did not appear to be an adventurer.

124.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_003_002
124.description: I have an ill foreboding about this individual, and I need you to investigate. I would do the deed myself, but I have my hands full with orders for buuz.

125.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_003_003
125.description: To begin with, I suggest you speak with Melodie. Do not delay─the continued survival of the Hard Place may well be at stake!

126.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_000
126.description: With your furnishings adorning this hall, we've been attracting new patrons not only with our food, but with our ambience as well. The result being we are doing better business than we have in many moons!

127.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_001
127.description: Which leads me to my next piece of news...

128.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_002
128.description: Finally, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─finally, we are profitable once more! Such a stellar recovery, we couldn't have achieved without you. I knew I was right to place my faith in you, my friend. Truly, I never cease to amaze myself with my powers of judgment.

129.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_003
129.description: Master Adkiragh! Lest you forget, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> is Zhloe's supplier first and foremost!

130.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_004
130.description: ...Heh heh, just kidding! By saving the Hard Place, you saved the orphanage as well. Now I can sleep at night again without having to count flatbread, which wasn't that helpful anyway because I'd run out at about five pieces.

131.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_005
131.description: Ah, but seeing Master Adkiragh's success has inspired Zhloe to redouble her efforts. Which is to say <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> have to redouble your efforts, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─for the children!

132.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_GEIMLONA_004_006
132.description: Allow me to express my gratitude too, adventurer. With the Hard Place prosperin' again, your fellow adventurers're startin' to return to Idyllshire.

133.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_GEIMLONA_004_007
133.description: As a woman of the House and a citizen of Idyllshire both─thank you, from the bottom of my heart.

134.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_008
134.description: I have experienced many and more hardships in my life, but this one alone, I do not think I could have overcome without your help.

135.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_009
135.description: The Hard Place is more than just a tavern. It is the only home the children of the orphanage know, and a place where dreamers of all walks may gather to rest away their cares.

136.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_010
136.description: That this place could be all of these things is because you and other kind souls have reached out a helping hand to this piggy. For that, I give you my heartfelt thanks.

137.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_011
137.description: Now, come, my friend! Let us keep up our great work!

138.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_MAPOPO_001_100
138.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I was wondering when you'd come by again.

139.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_MAPOPO_001_101
139.description: I have a proposal I'd like to run by you and the chief.

140.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_MAPOPO_001_102
140.description: You see, after Melodie came to us, I found I had a little more spare time. So I started learning some alchemy from the goblins, and I've gotten as far as being able to make a simple distiller.

141.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_MAPOPO_001_103
141.description: That gave me an idea: what if we were to make a house spirit to serve to our patrons?

142.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_001_104
142.description: Hmmm, the Hard Place's very own drop... I do like the sound of that. And if we are to reverse our fortunes, we must not shy from a challenge. Yes, let us undertake this endeavor!

143.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_001_105
143.description: Once again, we must rely on your help, my friend. Will you procure for us the items we need to make our own spirit?

144.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_001_106
144.description: That's the spirit! Pun shamelessly intended!

145.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ALGHU_002_100
145.description: For as long as we can remember, the chief has always hidden his true identity to others. It's unheard of for him to trust an outsider.

146.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_101
146.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> has earned my trust thrice over. It is by virtue of <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> help that this tavern still exists, and if you two mean to remain here, then I expect you to make a contribution as well.

147.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ALGHU_002_102
147.description: Well then, chief, I have an idea. A new type of buuz invented by the Mol has been popular of late. With your permission, we'll return to the Steppe to learn the secrets of its making.

148.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_TELEBOGE_002_103
148.description: Ah, yes, the one with the new filling. While we're there, we can gather the ingredients as well so we can make it here!

149.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_TELEBOGE_002_104
149.description: Oh, and worry not, chief─we'll take care not to be seen by our tribesmen.

150.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_105
150.description: While the idea is sound, I have my doubts about their ability to carry it out. I would feel much more at ease if you were to assist them.

151.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_106
151.description: Dependable as always. We are so close to becoming profitable again; let us not lose our momentum. Go forth, my friend, and bring us the ingredients for making this new buuz!

152.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_100
152.description: There is something I wish to speak with you about.

153.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_101
153.description: When first I came to Eorzea, an outsider without a gil to his name, Idyllshire was the only place that welcomed me.

154.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_102
154.description: The Ishgardians, for instance, judged me solely by my appearance, looking me up and down before turning me away. So much for “civilized” peoples, I thought.

155.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_103
155.description: My own tribe is no better. The Adarkim are ever racked by internal feuds, rivals trying to get the better of one another. The idiocy of it all left me bitter and jaded.

156.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_104
156.description: But this town restored my faith in my fellow man. Here, folk of all races and walks of life live together in harmony, joining hands in common cause. Fondly do I remember when I first set about establishing the Hard Place. One after the next, my neighbors came and offered me unsolicited help.

157.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_105
157.description: They've done me a good turn. It's only fair that I return the favor. This I mean to do by making the Hard Place the best place it can be.

158.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_106
158.description: A place where folk can relax and eat their fill. Where they can raise their cups in good times and in bad. Where they can chatter about everything and nothing until the break of dawn.

161.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_109
161.description: Everything that Idyllshire has given me, I intend to give back and more. To that end, I hope that I can continue to rely on your help.

162.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_110
162.description: ...What's that? You wonder why I still wear my disguise, though there is no longer a need to hide? Well, by now it has become a part of my identity. My brand, if you will.

163.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_111
163.description: That being said, as a businessman, I'm well aware of the import of staying abreast of prevailing trends. Moreover, I'm ever on the lookout for opportunities to broaden my horizons.

164.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_LCUT_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_112
164.description: Therefore, I give you permission to use glamour prisms upon me. With your surpassing fashion sense, give me an appearance that you think will speak to our clientele!

165.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUPINFO_000_000
165.description: Adkiragh is pleased with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Friend of the Hard Place<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

166.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUPINFO_000_001
166.description: Adkiragh is delighted with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Supporter of the Hard Place<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

167.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUPINFO_000_002
167.description: Adkiragh is overjoyed with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Cornerstone of the Hard Place<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

168.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUPINFO_000_003
168.description: Adkiragh could not be happier with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Savior of the Hard Place<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

169.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUPINFO_001_001
169.description: And yet there is still much work to be done if the Hard Place is to not only survive, but thrive as well. To that end, Adkiragh has a new favor to ask of you...

170.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUPINFO_001_002
170.description: Through your efforts, the Hard Place has managed to turn its financial fortunes around. It seems, however, that Adkiragh has a different sort of favor to ask of you...

171.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_AFTRANKUP_000_001
171.description: The Custom Deliveries list for Adkiragh has been updated. To view the new list, speak with Adkiragh and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

172.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_AFTRANKUP_001_001
172.description: A new quest continuing the story of the Hard Place's financial fortunes is now available from Melodie. Upon its completion, the Custom Deliveries list for Adkiragh will be updated.

173.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_AFTRANKUP_002_001
173.description: Future requests will be selected at random from all those you have seen thus far, with the list refreshed once a week (Earth time).

174.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_AFTRANKUP_002_002
174.description: You may review the items currently in demand at any time by speaking with Adkiragh and selecting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

175.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_AFTRANKUP_002_003
175.description: Note that arkhi brewing essentials, distillery materials, and Othardian salmon will earn you particularly handsome rewards. Whenever they make an appearance, the effort to procure them will be worth your while.

176.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_AFTRANKUP_002_004
176.description: Furthermore, Adkiragh's appearance may now be altered through the use of glamours.

177.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_001_000
177.description: Many thanks for your many deliveries, my friend.

178.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_001_001
178.description: Truly, you are skilled at what you do─and truly, I have a keen eye for skill.

179.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_000
179.description: I would swear, no sooner do you make a delivery than you reappear to make another. Your work ethic is astounding, my friend, and the Hard Place is better for it.

180.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_002_001
180.description: We're seeing more patrons than ever before, and you can take credit for this achievement. Well, <hex:021A020203>some<hex:021A020103> of it at any rate. It wouldn't be fair to attribute all of this to you, now, would it?

181.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_003_000
181.description: Owing to your unflagging effort, the Hard Place continues to do brisk business.

182.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_003_001
182.description: And yet, while I appreciate your dedication to our cause, I would not deny your talents to others. As a khan must give satisfaction to many women, so too should you apply yourself for the good of many.

183.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_003_002
183.description: But even the most tireless among us need rest. Whenever the rigors of life take their toll, you may always return here─to bask in the restorative presence of yours truly.

184.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_000
184.description: My thanks again for contributing to the cause.

185.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_001
185.description: ...Hm? I see you are burning to ask me about my attire. Come now, there's no use trying to hide it─your eyes all but say, “Such an amazing tale it must have been that saw him take up the swine head!”

186.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_004_002
186.description: Well, my friend, before I came to this town, I whiled away some of my idle time at the Gold Saucer. One of the attendants─a rather ravishing wench─said that the sleepy eyes and droopy ears would suit me well. And the rest, as they say, is history.

188.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_005_001
188.description: ...Hm? Come now, do not be coy. You are dying to know how I obtained the funds to open this place.

189.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_005_002
189.description: Well, it will come as no surprise that I am a peerless hunter, and the fiends of this land are as timid livestock to me. By taking on odd jobs, be it procuring materials or escorting the elderly, I amassed enough to get my start.

190.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_006_000
190.description: On behalf of all of the staff, I want to thank you for your tremendous contributions to our cause.

191.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_006_001
191.description: To think on it, had the Hard Place not been threatened with closure, our paths may never have crossed. Life truly is filled with twists and turns.

192.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_006_002
192.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, naught gives me more joy than to see the fruits of your labor bringing happiness to our patrons.

193.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_006_003
193.description: That is when I feel most keenly that we are making a difference in this town. Then the tears well up unbidden, and I─

194.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_RANKUP_ADKIRAGH_006_004
194.description: ...Hah! The illustrious Adkiragh, entrepreneur of steel, shedding tears? The mere suggestion is laughable! Hah hah hah!

195.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_AFTWEEKLY_000_000
195.description: You have delivered the weekly maximum of six items to Adkiragh. You may begin making deliveries again starting <hex:020603120303><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> at <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).

196.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_QUEST_ADKIRAGH_000_000
196.description: I suggest you first speak with Melodie. Do not delay─the continued survival of the Hard Place may well be at stake!

197.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER4_00541_QUEST_SYSTEM_000_001
197.description: In order to undertake the next quest, speak with Melodie at the Hard Place as a Disciple of the Hand or the Land.
